title: Origins: Glorp
description: Origin datapack that adds the Glorp Origin
body:
This datapack adds the Glorp origin, everyone's favourite gnarpy alien-cat.

Made for the 2025 Origins: Phone Home jam
## 🟢Abilities🟢
### Glorpballs
You can fire a glorpball as an effective defence mechanism, causing hit entities to be dazed.
Glorpballs fired/thrown by you will drop upon hitting an entity, upon which it can be thrown again or eaten whilst sneaking.
### Zooble
When on low health, you can randomly teleport away upon being hit to escape.
### Gnarping
You passively make gnarping sounds. (Requires resourcepack)
### Glump
You naturally jump higher than normal.
### Acrobatics
You never take fall damage, no matter from which height you fall.
### Catlike Appearance
Creepers are scared of you and will only explode if you attack them first.
### Nocturnal
You can slightly see in the dark when not in water.
### Hydrophobia
You receive damage over time while in contact with water.
### Glorpballism
Normal food has no satiating effect, you must eat Glorpballs for nourishment.
### Gnasty
You have weak physical defence, and loud noises are especially brutal.
### Toxic Heat
Hot environments are toxic to you, weakening you.
### Nine Lives
You have one less heart of health than humans.
#### Hidden Powers
You are green, and are able to tame cats instantly using your fists.
